subject: Request: mid-month seat add-on proration & VAT invoice
messages:
From: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@crestline.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: finance@crestline.ai
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: mid-month seat add-on proration & VAT invoice

Hi Stephanie,

We added 3 additional seats to our Dedicated pool on June 10th (mid-cycle for our 1st-of-month billing). Our AP needs a prorated invoice that shows the line-by-line calculation (per-seat, days charged, subtotal, VAT) so we can book it against June P&L. Can Redwood provide an interim invoice for the partial month and include our EU VAT number (IE1234567V) on the invoice header?

Quick details:
- Customer: Crestline Therapeutics (EU)
- Original billing cycle: 1st of month
- Seat add date: 2027-06-10
- Added seats: +3 (same seat tier)

Also planning to pay via corporate card today. If you can send the payable invoice (PDF) and a payment link, that would be ideal so we can clear this same day.

Thanks — appreciate the quick help.

Tom Hsu
Head of Infrastructure, Crestline Therapeutics
finance@crestline.ai

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@crestline.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: mid-month seat add-on proration & VAT invoice

Hi Tom — thanks for the details and the heads-up on payment timing. Looping in Ben (billing) and Marissa (finance) to produce an interim VAT-inclusive invoice and payment link. A couple quick confirmations before we generate the PDF:

- Just to confirm: the 3 seats were added to the existing seat tier (no discount/promo)?
- Do you want the invoice billed to the Crestline EU entity (please confirm legal name and full VAT: "Crestline Therapeutics Ltd, IE1234567V")?
- Would you prefer we net the prorated amount on your next full invoice or issue a standalone interim invoice for the partial period? We can do either but we typically issue a standalone pro-rata invoice for same-day payment.

If you reply with the confirmation on the three bullets we will turn around a payable PDF and include the VAT registration details in the invoice header. Ben / Marissa — please prepare a provisional prorated invoice (itemized calc + VAT at 20%) and attach the VAT certificate placeholder. I expect this to be under €x,xxx but will leave the exact math to billing.

Thanks,

— Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@crestline.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: mid-month seat add-on proration & VAT invoice

Hi Tom / Stephanie — putting the calculation here and attaching the interim invoice + VAT cert as requested. Attachment: prorated_invoice_Crestline_20270621.pdf, crestline_vat_certificate_20270621.pdf

Summary of calculation (invoice INV-20270621-CL):
- Seat list price (monthly): €1,200.00 per seat
- Seats added: 3
- Monthly cost for added seats: 3 x €1,200.00 = €3,600.00
- Billing cycle days (June): 30 days; seats added on June 10 -> chargeable days = 21 (10th included -> 10–30 inclusive)
- Prorate factor: 21 / 30 = 0.7
- Prorated subtotal: €3,600.00 x 0.7 = €2,520.00
- VAT (20%): €504.00
- Total payable (EU invoice): €3,024.00

Notes: we included an itemized line showing per-seat/day rate (€1,200 / 30 = €40.00 per seat-day) for AP reconciliation. The interim PDF shows Crestline Therapeutics Ltd and VAT IE1234567V in the invoice header per your request.

Payment options:
- Pay via the included card payment link (one-click) — preferred for same-day clearing.
- Bank transfer — please reply and we will send bank remittance instructions (note: bank transfers can take 2–3 business days).

If you pay by card, please upload or send the payment receipt and we will issue a final VAT invoice marked as paid. Happy to expedite any changes if the legal name/VAT differs.

Best,
Ben Carter
Billing Manager, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
Attachments: prorated_invoice_Crestline_20270621.pdf (PDF, 1 page, itemized) ; crestline_vat_certificate_20270621.pdf (PDF, customer-supplied VAT ID placeholder)

From: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@crestline.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Petrov <e.petrov@payhub.co>, finance@crestline.ai
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 15:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: mid-month seat add-on proration & VAT invoice

Thanks Ben — received the invoice and the breakdown looks good. We just processed the payment by corporate card and attached the payment intent/receipt here for your records (payment_intent_receipt_crestline_20270622.png).

Two final asks so our AP can close the ticket:
1) Please confirm the invoice header in the final VAT invoice exactly matches this legal name and VAT: "Crestline Therapeutics Ltd, IE1234567V".
2) Please add an explicit VAT line with the percentage (20%) and the amount (as you did in the provisional PDF) so our system can automatically reconcile the tax line.

If you can mark INV-20270621-CL as paid and send the final stamped VAT invoice (PDF) we will archive it.

Appreciate the fast turnaround — Tom

--
Tom Hsu
Head of Infrastructure, Crestline Therapeutics
finance@crestline.ai
